'''''Carissa bispinosa''''' grows as a shrub or small tree up to {{convert|5|m}} tall. Its fragrant flowers feature a white [[Corolla (flower)|corolla]]. The fruit is red when ripe. Its habitat is woodland and forest from {{convert|1080|m|abbr=on}} to {{convert|1630|m|abbr=on}} elevation. Vernacular names for the plant include '''forest num-num''' and '''Y-thorned carissa'''.<ref name=FOZ>{{cite web | title = ''Carissa bispinosa'' | url = http://www.zimbabweflora.co.zw/speciesdata/species.php?species_id=144930 | work = Flora of Zimbabwe | access-date = 6 August 2013}}</ref> ''Carissa bispinosa'' is native to an area from Uganda to South Africa.<ref name="iucn status 20 November 2021" />
